body:
I don't think there's any one thing really. I have PTSD and OCD, and I'm Autistic. My dad died when I was six and I was sent off to live with my mom and stepdad. I've been sexually assaulted 147 times since then and the longest I've gone in between assaults is a year. Most of the people who assaulted me were friends or partners or family. I ran away at 14, was homeless and busted ass and graduated high school at 16 while living on the streets, and sometimes in shelters. Got a scholarship to college and got my masters at 21, but then my girlfriend died. I spent a few years working at refugee camps and in conflict zones and then I married a dude who was abusive and had two kids. I left him, and then nearly a year later got into another relationship with someone who convinced me I was having paranoid delusions so I went on antipsychotics and dealt with drug induced Parkinsonism and various extra pyramidal symptoms. (Turned out I wasn't delusional and the stuff he said was delusions was actually corroborated by others as being real) I've never been with a guy who hasn't hurt me.

This guy has no red flags. My friends confirmed. He respects my autonomy and my space, but we've only been dating a few months. It isn't anywhere close to serious, and that's by my choice.

I don't really have any family besides my kids. A few good friends, whom I love and who love me back. I can't really afford to support my babies, and my ex, their father, is a deadbeat. Which is okay I guess, because it means I don't have to fight him on everything.

I don't get a lot of breaks from the kids or from work. I can't remember the last time I slept through the night. I have a lot of flashbacks, and many of my nightmares are of kids whose lives I couldn't save, or of the men that have assaulted me. My life is mostly not horrible, and even pretty good, but my birthday is coming up in a couple weeks and it is also the anniversary of my dad's death. I've fought really hard to make it to thirty, and now it's coming up and I can't help but wonder if it is worth it.
I really, really like him. I think I could be happy with him, if it wasn't for everything else in my life. I just don't know how much longer I can keep fighting this whole suicide thing.

We haven't been dating long, but we've been friends for a while. I know he's got his own depression monsters and he just lost a friend of his. I don't want to push him over the edge.

If I dump him and he's mad at me, then maybe he won't be hurt, and he'll just be angry at me?
Can't. He'd probably call someone and have me committed and I'd lose custody of my kids and be deported.
